6396.title: Reduced-motion input-level feedback
6396.rootCauseOneLine: The reduced-motion fallback returns before audio analysis and draws constant idle bars for active input.
6396.proposedFix: Keep audio analysis active and replace scrolling history with a stationary current-level display under reduced motion.
6396.caveats: Isolated real-Chromium component and focused regression, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout; Android hardware and full transcription were not tested.
